snippet.title: Revenant of Tsushima | Official Teaser Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
Revenant of Tsushima
is a first-person Japanese folk-horror game set along the Tōkaidō during the Edo period.

Awaken as Tsushima Mewa, a forbidden shrine maiden sealed away for centuries. Pursued by the shogunate and haunted by wandering spirits, she must reconstruct her identity, escape the burden of godhood, and find her way home....

Explore forgotten roads, perceive the unseen through Ether Sight, capture restless spirits, and perform rituals shaped by Japanese folklore...

Official Website:
https://revenant-tsushima.aurora-studio.org/en/

Developed by Aurora Studio:
